degree_rationale: How the Father poured forth the malformations onto the earth in stages — eating them upon the earth, casting them out, then onto the three roads (sea-saltness, mountain of darkness, fire-mountains). Illumines the staged casting-down.
direction_rationale: Wisdom illumining the staged purification — why and how each malformation was cast out in turn. The 'why upon earth first?' illumination.
grand_man_function: Spiritual staged-cleansing — the illumined sequence of cosmic-evacuation.
title: How the Father poured forth the malformations onto the earth in stages
